title: Checkpoint: Serializer with specialization
prompt: Implement `template <typename T> struct Serializer` with `static std::string to(const T&)` producing `std::to_string(v)`; a **full specialization** for `std::string` returning the string unchanged; and a **partial specialization** for `std::vector<T>` producing `"[a,b,c]"` (no spaces), recursively serializing elements. Nested vectors must work: a `std::vector<std::vector<int>>` serializes as `"[[1,2],[3]]"`.

tests.name: int
tests.hint: The primary template handles numeric types.

tests.name: string
tests.hint: The full specialization passes text through unchanged.

tests.name: vector-int
tests.hint: The partial specialization joins with commas.

tests.name: nested
tests.hint: Recursion through the generic composes the output.
